# v0.8.0b4 — Stable entities and per-vehicle targets

Beta of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains stable.**

Changes compared with 0.8.0b3:

- **No more brief "unavailable":** a single disturbed Modbus read made every
  entity of the affected register block, such as the charging release,
  unavailable until the next poll. Recently read status and measurement values
  are now kept for up to 30 seconds. The energy meter and error recovery still
  use only fresh reads. In service mode this needs **app 0.8.0b4**.
- **The selected car stays:** automatic vehicle selection no longer drops the
  car when it is unplugged or its reports are stale, which reloaded all
  entities. It ends the selection when another car reports itself plugged in,
  or when the wallbox sees a car while the selected one reports itself
  elsewhere; an unknown car then has no percentage target.
- **Targets per vehicle:** each profile remembers its percentage target.
  Returning to a car restores it, capped at its current limit, instead of 0.
- **No surprise charging after a restart:** Virtual Plug & Charge lifts a manual
  pause and adopts the car's limit only for a plug-in observed after unplugging.
  After an HA or app restart, update or reconnect with the car still connected,
  the grant returns but the pause and target stay.
- **Counter for broken Modbus transactions:** connection quality has a new
  attribute, *Failed transactions*. It counts timeouts and malformed responses
  since the last start, including reads that only succeeded on retry, and
  changes only on a failure. In service mode this needs **app 0.8.0b4**.

Keep your existing HA entry and app data. When updating both components, update
the app to **0.8.0b4 through #apps-beta first**, wait for initialization, then
update the integration. Ordinary service connections still require **API 2 and
service 0.6.1 or newer**; Plug & Charge needs **app 0.8.0b1 or newer**.
**#apps stays on stable 0.6.1.** Direct USB/LAN needs no app.
